Codex-style composer predictions for DeepSeek Harness
After each reply, your next prompt is ghosted right into the composer — Enter / Tab / → to accept, p
ress again to send, Esc to dismiss, start typing and it's gone
🌏 中文 · English
`dsh-prompt-predict` is a DeepSeek Harness plugin: after every assistant turn it predicts **the mess
age you are most likely to type next** and floats it into the composer as gray ghost text. The sugge
stion never enters the editor — only pressing `Enter`, `Tab` or `→` inserts it, and even then it sta
ys undoable — so a wrong prediction costs you nothing.
## 🇷🇺 Что даёт этот форк / What this build adds
- **Подсказка появляется сразу после хода** — хост генерирует и кэширует предсказание, как только аг

ент ушёл в idle; composer не ждёт сетевого запроса при возврате в окно.
- **Свои настройки подсказки
** — режим «только по Tab» (без автозапуска), собственный системный промпт и дополнительные инструкц

ии к каждой генерации.
- **Принятие по Enter / Tab / →, отправка вторым нажатием** — повторное нажат

ие той же клавиши сразу отправляет принятый текст.
- **Русский интерфейс** — полный словарь клиента

(149 ключей) и русские причины ошибок от хоста; язык берётся из локали DSH.
- **Меньше визуального ш
ума** — строки хинтов `Tab / ↓ / Esc` под ghost нет; осталась одна компактная кнопка `↻` для смены п

одсказки и служебные пометки «обрезано» / лимит переключений.
- **Старая подсказка не пересчитываетс
я** — пока она видна в поле, автоматический ответ её не заменяет; новый вариант только по `↓`, `↻` и

ли `Ctrl+Shift+Space`.
- **Тесты** — 146 проверок хоста и 214 проверок клиентского рендера.
Поведение отличается от апстрима: строка хинтов убрана, смена подсказки — по `↓`, кнопке `↻` или `Ct
ется от апстрима: строка хинтов убрана, смена подсказки — по `↓`, кнопке `↻` или `Ctrl+Shift+Space`.

## ✨ Features
- **Single-line or multi-line** — sentences stay one line; code snippets, lists and multi-paragraph

replies keep their line breaks and indentation
- **A suggestion the moment a reply ends** — gray gho
st text rendered at the composer's first character, matching the editor's caret position, font size

and line height
- **Three ways to accept** — `Enter`, `Tab` or `→` inserts the ghost, and pressing t
he same key again sends the message; `↓` asks for a different suggestion, `Esc` dismisses; typing hi

des it, and clearing the draft brings it back
- **Lightweight context** — only the most recent user/

assistant *text*; tool results, attachments and system prompts never leave your machine
- **Follows
the current session model by default** — nothing is hard-coded to a provider, the prediction call re

uses whatever model the session itself uses; you can also pin a cheaper model
- **No repeats, no dea
d ends** — a repeat of the previous suggestion triggers an automatic "give me a different one"; a re
asoning level the real model doesn't support falls back automatically, so you never hit "settings lo

ok fine but no suggestion ever appears"
- **Everything is adjustable** — on/off, provider / model, r
esponse timeout, context size and budget, output cap, reasoning effort; changes apply immediately, n

o DSH restart
- **Light and dark** — the ghost text, settings page and history follow the system/app

colour scheme (`prefers-color-scheme`), with contrast kept at WCAG AA in both
[该节后续省略]
### Requirements

- Verified on **DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`** (web build; the desktop app runs the same host and client code)
-
`node` / `pnpm`: the install script prefers DSH's own runtime under `~/.dsh/dsh-runtimes/*/dependen

cies` and only falls back to `PATH`
- macOS / Linux; Windows untested
## 🔐 Security and cost
- **One** small helper call per assistant turn by default; an extra attempt only happens when the re
ply hits the length limit, the reasoning level needs downgrading, or a suggestion needs rerolling —
**four calls is the hard ceiling** (primary, reasoning-level fallback, length retry, reroll), and th

ey share a single timeout budget
- Suggestions are **not written to the session log**; only after yo

u accept with `Enter`/`Tab`/`→` and send does the text become a real message
- Only trimmed user/ass

istant plain text is sent — tool results, attachments and system prompts never leave the machine
- B
oth the settings page and the suggestion endpoint sit behind DSH's own browser-cookie authentication
## ⚠️ Known limitations

- Verified only on DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`; other versions untested
- Depends on the host's `conversation.c

omposer.dock` and `settings.section` slot names — a major DSH update may require adapting
- Predicti
ons consume quota on the selected model; pinning a fast small model is cheaper than following a reas
quota on the selected model; pinning a fast small model is cheaper than following a reasoning model
